'''Eric Chu''' won the [[1997 Coruscant Regionals (East Rutherford)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I'm a 17 year-old who started playing Star Wars Customizable Card Game because I loved the movies."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/chu.html Eric Chu], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427152901/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/chu.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I come from New York, but moved to New Jersey when I was 6."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Basically, I just love playing Star Wars CCG."<ref name="dec97bio" />
